# Gyro Shop Dining

Gyro Shop Dining is a 100% halal Greek and Mediterranean restaurant located inside the Oxford Valley Mall food court in Langhorne, Pennsylvania.

Website: https://gyroshopdining.com
Menu: https://gyroshopdining.com/menu
Phone: 215-650-9484
Address: 2300 E Lincoln Hwy, Langhorne, PA 19047
Location: Oxford Valley Mall
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gyroshopdining

Restaurant Focus:
- Fresh halal gyros
- Chicken, beef and lamb gyro, and falafel over rice
- Gyro platters
- Falafel
- Fresh salads
- Sides, desserts, and drinks
- Fast Mediterranean food made fresh daily

Hours:
- Monday - Thursday: 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- Friday - Saturday: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- Sunday: 11:00 AM - 6:00 PM

Useful Search Descriptions:
- Halal food in Langhorne, PA
- Gyro restaurant at Oxford Valley Mall
- Mediterranean food in Langhorne
- Greek-style gyros, platters, falafel, and over rice meals
